summary: Ampere expanded instance availability across European cloud providers to serve AI inference and sovereign cloud demand, allowing regional clouds and telcos to spin up compliant, energy-efficient AI infrastructure quickly. This supply-side expansion allows regional players to outpace traditional carriers lacking ready compute infrastructure for model serving.
raw_excerpt: New AmpereOne-based cloud instances roll out across hyperscale and regional providers as AI inference demand, power constraints, and sovereign cloud requirements reshape Europe’s infrastructure strategy.
